```python
import platform
import os
import webbrowser
import sys

def get_system_info():
    """Prints basic system information."""
    print("\n--- System Information ---")
    print(f"Operating System: {platform.system()} {platform.release()} ({platform.version()})")
    print(f"Architecture: {platform.machine()}")
    print(f"Python Version: {platform.python_version()}")
    print(f"Node Name: {platform.node()}")
    print(f"Processor: {platform.processor()}")
    print("--------------------------\n")

def list_directory_contents():
    """Lists files and directories in a specified path."""
    path = input("Enter the directory path to list (e.g., C:\\Users\\YourName or /home/yourname): ")
    if not os.path.isdir(path):
        print(f"Error: Directory '{path}' not found.")
        return

    print(f"\n--- Contents of '{path}' ---")
    with os.scandir(path) as entries:
        for entry in entries:
            if entry.is_file():
                print(f"  FILE: {entry.name}")
            elif entry.is_dir():
                print(f"  DIR:  {entry.name}")
    print("----------------------------\n")

def open_web_link():
    """Opens a specified URL in the default web browser."""
    url = input("Enter the URL to open (e.g., https://www.google.com): ")
    if not url.startswith("http://") and not url.startswith("https://"):
        url = "https://" + url # Prepend https:// if not present
    try:
        webbrowser.open(url)
        print(f"Opening {url} in your default browser...\n")
    except webbrowser.Error:
        print(f"Error: Could not open URL '{url}'. Please check your browser configuration.\n")

def main_menu():
    """Displays the main menu and handles user choices."""
    while True:
        print("Jarvis Multipurpose Script Menu:")
        print("1. Get System Information")
        print("2. List Directory Contents")
        print("3. Open Web Link")
        print("4. Exit")

        choice = input("Enter your choice (1-4): ")

        if choice == '1':
            get_system_info()
        elif choice == '2':
            list_directory_contents()
        elif choice == '3':
            open_web_link()
        elif choice == '4':
            print("Exiting script. Goodbye, Boss!")
            sys.exit()
        else:
            print("Invalid choice. Please enter a number between 1 and 4.\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("Hello Boss. Initializing Multipurpose Python Script...")
    main_menu()
```
